question: What is the name of the mascot for Khelo India Youth Games 2025, Bihar?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Gajasimha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Khelo India Youth Games 2025: Bihar Launches Mascot 'Gaj Singh'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Nitish Kumar**, CM of Bihar, unveiled the **official logo** of **Khelo India Youth Games, Bihar 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya** participated **remotely**, and both launched the **sports song** and **flagged off the torch**.

 
 
• 
 
**PM Narendra Modi** will **inaugurate** the event in **Patna on May 4, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time** Bihar is hosting **Khelo India Youth Games**.

 
 
• 
 
The games will run from **May 4 to May 15** across **5 districts**: Patna, Nalanda (Rajgir), Gaya, Bhagalpur, Begusarai.

 
 
• 
 
**8,500 players** and **1,500 technical staff** will participate in **28 sports**—totaling around **10,000 people**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Mashal Gaurav Yatra (torch relay)** will cover **38 districts** from **April 15 to May 2**.

 
 
• 
 
The **logo** features:

 
 
• 
 
**Orange & green** (excitement & nature)

 
 
• 
 
**Mascot '****Gajasimha****'**: inspired by **Pala-period sculptures** (elephant-lion hybrid)

 
 
• 
 
Icons from **Nalanda University**, **Mahabodhi Temple**, **Peepal trees**, **Gangetic dolphins**, **Madhubani art**, **Chhath Puja**, and **Valmiki Tiger Reserve**

 
 
• 
 
**Ashok Chakra** and **lion** symbolizing **justice and strength**

 
 
• 
 
The slogan: **“Colors of the game!”** reflects Bihar’s cultural and sporting revival
